_comment: Phase-16 scale probe fixture: PyTorch CNN on raw 28x28 MNIST (784 encrypted pixels), exported to ONNX opset 13, lowered via penumbra.load_onnx, and quantized via penumbra.Model.quantize. The model is Conv2d(1, 4, 3, stride=4) -> ReLU -> Linear(196, 10). The 10 logits are graph outputs. Decrypted FHE logits must match expected_logits bit-for-bit.
